utfall: jobbstabilitet ved kortere dagpengeperiode (simulert, høyst 4.3 prosent økning)
sitat: We simulate alternative UIB designs and conclude that shortening the benefit entitlement length does not seem to lead to significant gains in overall employment stability which increases by 4.3% at most.

utfall: ingen effektestimat; lengre periode gir lengre ledighet men bedre jobbmatch, særlig for midlertidig ansatte
sitat: We find that the UIB entitlement period lengthens the unemployment spell of all workers but it also has a positive effect on the quality of subsequent job matches, particularly for temporary workers, and when job entrance takes place by the end of benefits entitlement.
